description: This file contains platform-specific script functions for performing upgrades on various hardware boards within an OpenWrt build system. It defines functions to check images, perform upgrades for different device models, and copy configurations depending on the board.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Stub function that always returns success (0), likely used to verify image validity.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Main upgrade dispatcher that performs device-specific upgrade steps based on the board name, such as flashing firmware, preparing eMMC, or setting environment variables.

methods.name: platform_copy_config
methods.description: Function to copy configuration files to the device, depending on the board, e.g., via eMMC.
